headline: Xcel Energy Inc. Board Declares Dividend on Common Stock
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, July 29, 2026--The Board of Directors of Xcel Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: XEL) today declared a quarterly dividend on its common stock of 59.25 cents per share. The dividends are payable October 20, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 15, 2026.

headline: Xcel Energy Elects Peter Carter to Board of Directors
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, July 29, 2026--Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) announced that Peter Carter has been elected to its board of directors, effective today.
